title: Refrigerant R134a: HFC, HCFC and CFC emissions exactly 10× the ecoinvent process
observation: HFC-134a 0.019, HCFC-124 0.010, CFC-113 0.010 kg per kg — each exactly 10× the corresponding ecoinvent 3.6 dataset (0.0019 / 0.001 / 0.001); GWP100 108.6 against roughly 19. A documented process difference or a unit slip?
validation_scope: Compared on the release files with the corresponding ecoinvent 3.6 dataset; whether it is a documented process difference is the open question.
next_action: Ask BAFU whether the factor of 10 is a documented process difference or a unit slip.
